name: AWS: Cross-Account S3 Bucket Access
query:
MATCH p=(source)-[:AWS_S3BucketRead|AWS_S3BucketWrite|AWS_S3BucketAll]->(b:AWS_S3Bucket)
WHERE source.account_id <> b.account_id
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
description: Bucket-level access edges that cross an account boundary — principals reaching buckets owned by a different account via bucket policy or IAM.
